dota2tracker.description: A series of commands for Dota 2 Tracker. Use dota2tracker -h to see all available commands, or use dota2tracker.help to see a detailed description of all commands.

subscribe.description: Subscribes the current channel to Dota 2 match tracking.
subscribe.usage: After subscribing, players need to bind their Steam ID in this channel. The bot will then track new matches of bound players and post image-based reports upon completion of parsing by Stratz.

messages.subscribed: This Channel has been subscribed, no need to subscribe again.

unsubscribe.description: Unsubscribes the current channel from match tracking.
unsubscribe.usage: Unsubscribes the current channel from match tracking.

messages.not_subscribed: This Channel has not been subscribed yet, so there is no need to unsubscribe.

bind.description: Binds your SteamID to your account in the current channel.
bind.usage: Bind your SteamID to your account. If the channel is subscribed, your new match data will be posted automatically. Nicknames containing spaces must be enclosed in double quotes ("").

messages.reason_without_match: Invalid SteamID or no matches found.
messages.reason_fetch_failed: Poor network conditions or other reasons prevented the verification of the SteamID. Please try again later.
messages.nick_name_too_long: Nickname is too long, please limit it to 20 characters or less. (It can also be left blank)

If you need to make data public, please set it to public in the DOTA2 game settings.

unbind.description: Unbinds your personal information in the current channel.
unbind.usage: Unbind your personal information in the current channel.

messages.not_binded: Not bound, no need to unbind.

rename.description: Changes the nickname set during binding.
rename.usage: Change the nickname set during binding. Nicknames containing spaces must be enclosed in double quotes ("").

messages.not_binded: Please bind first, you can set a nickname during binding.
messages.nick_name_too_long: Nickname is too long, please limit it to 20 characters.

query-recent-match.description: Query the most recent match data and generate a picture.

options.parse: Whether to wait for match data parsing

query-recent-match.usage:
Query the most recent match data of the specified player and generate a picture.
The parameter can be the player's SteamID or the nickname of a player bound in this group. If no parameter is provided, it will try to query the SteamID of the command caller.
query-recent-match.examples:
query-recent-match
query-recent-match 123456789
query-recent-match John
query-recent-match 123456789 -p
query-recent-match John --parse

query-player.description: Query the player's personal information, optionally specify a hero.

options.hero: Query the player's usage of the specified hero (same as querying a hero, can use nickname or ID)

query-player.usage:
Query the personal information of the specified player and generate a picture, optionally specify a hero.
The parameter can be the player's SteamID or the nickname of a player bound in this group. If no parameter is provided, it will try to query the SteamID of the command caller.
query-player.examples:
query-player
query-player 123456789
query-player John
query-player John --hero Anti-Mage
query-player John -o Anti-Mage

query-hero.usage:
Query the hero's skill descriptions and various stats, generate a picture.
The parameter can be the hero's ID, name, or common nickname.

hero-of-the-day.description: Get hero recommendations for the day.
hero-of-the-day.usage:
Fetches recent and lifetime match history to recommend heroes based on parameters like wins, performance score, and hot streaks.
The parameter can be a player's SteamID or the nickname of a player bound in this group. If no parameter is provided, it will try to look up the command caller's SteamID.

options.days: -d <number> The range of recent days to consider, default is 30.

messages.recommendation_intro: The recommended heroes for you today are:
messages.recommendation_type_lifetime_only: Your recent match history is empty. This recommendation is based on your lifetime statistics.
messages.recommendation_type_no_record: Recommendations cannot be generated due to a lack of recent and lifetime match data.
messages.recommendation_type_anonymous: Recommendations cannot be generated because your profile data is private.

details.pool_description: The recommendation is generated by scoring your recent and lifetime hero performance, sorting by total score, and then randomly selecting from the top 10 heroes weighted by their scores.
details.table_intro: Below is the detailed score breakdown for the top 10 heroes.
details.scoring_formula: Current Scoring Formula: [Recent Wins x 1] + [log(Lifetime Wins + 1) x 5] + [Recent IMP x 0.1]
details.hot_streak_desc: If a hero was played in the last 3 days, it's considered a 'Hot Streak' hero, receiving a 20% bonus to its total score.

messages.meta_intro: Top 3 advantage heroes for each position with a pick rate ≥2% within ±1 of your rank bracket ({tiers}) over the last week, sorted by win rate:
